name: Update Main Repository
description: This default task updates the Main Repository from the Trellix update site (TrellixHttp).

name: Translate Trellix EDR policies into Trellix EDR with Forensics
description: This task translates the Trellix EDR policies into Trellix EDR with Forensics.This task is initiated by the "Upgrade EDR Policy" menu

name: TIE Server Telemetry
description: TIE Server telemetry process to collect and transmit data from remote points.

name: TIE Server Synchronize Topology
description: It manages the synchronization of the TIE Server Topology in a multi-ePO environment.

name: TIE Server Synchronize CA
description: It manages the synchronization of the TIE Server CAs in a multi-ePO environment.

name: TIE Server Poll Malicious Verdicts from IVX Server
description: This will schedule the job to poll malicious verdicts from the IVX Server

name: TIE Server Notifications
description: Server task to trigger queries over TIE Server data and produce notifications for recommended actions.

name: TIE Server Monitoring
description: TIE Server monitoring mechanism to save events.

name: TIE Server Database Maintenance
description: TIE Server Database Maintenance trigger.

name: TIE Server Data Management
description: TIE Server Data Management cleanup trigger.

name: Synchronize Shared Tasks
description: Synchronize client tasks among designated registered servers.

name: Synchronize Shared Policies
description: Synchronize policies among designated registered servers.

name: Solidcore: Migration task
description: This task will run immediately after upgrade.Time consuming SQL queries will be executed by this task.

name: Solidcore: Auto Purge Policy Discovery Requests
description: Solidcore: Auto Purge Policy Discovery Requests older that 3 months.

name: Send DXL State Event
description: Send the current DXL State event to the DXL Fabric

name: Send DXL Certificate Revocations
description: Sends the full list of certificates revoked by the administrator. This task should be run after every new broker deployment.

name: Roll up Data (Local Trellix ePO server)
description: This default task creates roll up data for this Trellix ePO server for inclusion in multi-server reporting.

name: Purge Threat and Client Events Older than 90 Days
description: Delete Threat and Client event records older than 90 days.

name: Manage DXL Brokers
description: Evaluate each system against the DXLBROKER tag criteria and update DXL Broker Policies

name: LdapSync: Sync across users from LDAP
description: Syncs users from an LDAP server to the database

name: Generate Records for Trellix Agent Compliance History Reporting
description: This default task stores the results of the 'Trellix Agent Compliance Summary' query for use in reporting on compliance history.

name: ePO Health Check Scheduler Task
description: This task runs ePO default health checklist periodically.

name: ePO Database Index Maintenance
description: ePO Database Index Maintenance and statistics update

name: Endpoint Security Firewall Property Translator
description: Process properties received from client and convert them into rules.

name: Duplicate Agent GUID - remove systems with potentially duplicated GUIDs
description: Delete systems whose sequence error count has exceeded the threshold and add Agent GUID to duplicate list.

name: Duplicate Agent GUID - clear error count
description: Clear Sequence Error Count for systems who have not recently reported duplicate activities.

name: Download Software Product List
description: Downloads the list of software your license key has access to.

name: Disaster Recovery Snapshot Server
description: Built-in Disaster Recovery Snapshot Server Task (disabled by default for Microsoft SQL Server Express)

name: Apply TIESERVER Tags to TIE Servers
description: Evaluate each system against the TIESERVER tag criteria and tag the appropriate systems.
